# Which pieces make your upholstery shop money, and how many does the season have to sell?

> Free upholstery shop calculator: enter your chair seat, armchair and sofa prices, bench hours, fabric and foam cost, upholsterer pay and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the season result. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
